name: Wedding Planner Operations
audience: independent wedding planners and boutique planning teams
topic: vendor deliverables and client decisions for wedding planners

products.name: Vendor Deliverable Chaser
products.product: A focused wedding vendor deliverable tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent wedding planners and boutique planning teams
products.problem: Contracts name dozens of vendor deadlines, but questionnaires, certificates, floor plans, menus, and final counts are chased through unrelated email threads.
products.valueProposition: Turns wedding vendor deliverable tracking into a visible operating queue so every contracted vendor deliverable is received, reviewed, and reflected in the current wedding plan before its dependency date.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets wedding vendor checklist, vendor deliverable tracker, wedding planner deadline template, and wedding vendor follow up searches.

products.name: Client Decision Register
products.product: A focused wedding client decision tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent wedding planners and boutique planning teams
products.problem: Important choices are discussed in meetings, texts, and mood boards, making it difficult to know what the couple approved and which vendor work can proceed.
products.valueProposition: Turns wedding client decision tracking into a visible operating queue so every decision that blocks budget, design, or vendor work has one approved answer, effective version, and downstream owner.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets wedding decision tracker, client approval log wedding, wedding planning decisions, and wedding sign off template searches.
